name: Far Terrain LOD with Voxel Coverage Masking
definition: A rendering technique for distant terrain using multiple levels of detail (LOD) meshes that are discarded where voxel chunks are present, using a coverage mask to handle boundary transitions and prevent z-fighting or sky leaks.
summary: Far Terrain LOD with Voxel Coverage Masking renders distant terrain using LOD meshes discarded where voxel chunks exist, using a coverage mask to prevent z-fighting and sky leaks.
